title: XOM — Exxon Mobil
html:
Close: $178.98 · YTD: +51.7% · At its 52-week high ($179.16, Oct 16) Trend: strong uptrend — above the 20-day ($166.11), 50-day ($163.57) and 200-day ($150.39). RSI(14): 73 — overbought. Strong trends can stay overbought, but chasing here has poor risk/reward. ATR(14): $3.52 · Driver: oil above $100 (WTI $101.71) from Iran-related supply risk.
